name: partner-support-order-rescue
executionConcern: Partner support conversations and order-related incidents/rescue shared with authorized actor and operator consumers
objective: Make Partner support for owned Store/order converge on canonical DSH support/incident/rescue state, enforce actor isolation and canonical readback, and preserve client/captain compatibility without giving Partner rescue or WLT mutation authority.
truthOwner: DSH support, incident and order-rescue domains; operators own rescue transitions; WLT is read-only visibility where explicitly permitted.
journeys: operator order rescue and affected actor readback

tasks.objective: Close Partner support and operator rescue at DSH truth owner
tasks.currentProblem: Static Partner support guards do not prove ticket/message isolation, incident legality, internal-note redaction, rescue persistence or shared readback.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Partner ticket/message operations and operator incident/rescue transitions through contracts, actor/Store/order authorization, persistence/idempotency/audit and affected readbacks; correct owner-level mismatches.
tasks.targetState: Partner can operate only owned support scope; operator-only rescue remains separate and all authorized consumers read committed DSH state.
tasks.action: Fix DSH support/rescue owner first, migrate affected Partner/Client/Captain/operator consumers, remove proven local lifecycle remnants and rerun checks.
mustNotChange: Do not leak another actor/Store ticket or internal note.
Do not let Partner mutate incident/rescue state.
Do not create local support/rescue truth.
Do not mutate WLT from support/rescue.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner/Client/Captain/operator views receive only authorized canonical readback.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused support/rescue changes or roll forward at DSH while preserving incident/audit history.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U006 commit after DSH support/rescue owner and affected consumers align.

tasks.objective: Close support privacy, retry and recovery states
tasks.currentProblem: Happy-path support does not prove cross-actor denial, stale rescue transition, duplicate messages or refresh/offline recovery.
tasks.requiredChange: Add/repair negative isolation, idempotency/version conflict, redaction and canonical recovery states without broadening unrelated support surfaces.
tasks.targetState: Unauthorized IDs fail closed without sensitive disclosure; duplicates/stale transitions are deterministic; refresh reconstructs committed support/rescue state.
tasks.action: Change only shared support/rescue boundaries and directly affected consumers.
mustNotChange: Do not grant Partner operator permissions.
Do not use local success after failed mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-actor access is denied without leakage.
tasks.rollback: Revert consumer/recovery changes without weakening DSH authorization.
